intro: Part 3: a reference connects. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Flere familier bruger tilbuddet efter skoletid.

frases.estudio: De fortæller, at det gør hverdagen lettere.
frases.alumno: They say that it makes their everyday life easier.

texto: A title anticipates the topic, while the first sentence of a paragraph can present its central idea. Use connectors and pronouns to reconstruct the relationship between parts of the text.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
